title: Edit an active Space checklist collection
outcome: Open an isolated draft for one represented active Project or Business Inventory Space, edit its complete checklist structure and text, then cancel without mutation or save one durable revision-bound replacement with conflict recovery.

uiJourneys.targetPage: Target exact-Space detail and isolated checklist editor

controls.label: Edit

options.label: Open editor
options.result: Copies the represented active Space checklist hierarchy into an isolated stable-identity draft.

controls.action: Tap Edit in the expanded CHECKLISTS section.
controls.result: The editor opens only from complete represented active-Space evidence and performs no write.

controls.label: Checklist Name / Item text

options.label: Edit text
options.result: Changes only the local draft while preserving checklist and item identity.

controls.action: Edit any represented checklist name or item text.
controls.result: No command is accepted until Save; canonical target validation owns submitted text.

controls.label: Item checkbox

options.label: Checked / unchecked
options.result: Changes draft checked state and draft progress without invoking the immediate-toggle workflow.

controls.action: Toggle an item inside the editor.
controls.result: Only the draft changes until Save.

controls.label: Add Item / Add Checklist

options.label: Add Item
options.result: Appends one stable-ID draft item to its checklist.

options.label: Add Checklist
options.result: Appends one stable-ID draft checklist that may contain zero items.

controls.action: Add checklist structure in the editor.
controls.result: New identities and order are frozen in the draft and included only if saved.

controls.label: Delete / swipe delete

options.label: Delete Checklist
options.result: Removes that checklist and its draft items.

controls.result: Deletion remains local until one complete replacement is saved.

controls.label: Reorder

options.label: Move Item
options.result: Changes item presentation order within its checklist without changing stable identity.

controls.result: The saved complete hierarchy contains unique canonical presentation order.

controls.label: Save

options.label: Ready
options.result: After a semantic draft change, accepts exactly one full replacement bound to the represented Space revision, then shows pending state until authoritative settlement; an unchanged draft remains a no-op with Save disabled.

options.label: Saving / conflict
options.result: Prevents duplicate submission and preserves actionable draft/conflict evidence.

controls.result: Durable local acceptance precedes optimistic detail projection; rejection never silently discards the user's draft.

controls.label: Cancel

options.label: Discard never-submitted draft
options.result: Dismisses a local editor draft that was never durably accepted and dispatches no operation.

controls.result: Represented Space state is unchanged; Cancel is not a rejection-discard action.

controls.label: Review Rejected Draft

options.label: Open exact preserved command
options.result: Opens the rejected command's complete checklist collection as a read-only review, including after an encrypted database and app-model restart and without requiring current detail to reconstruct the draft.

controls.action: Open the recovery action shown for the selected Space.
controls.result: The exact rejected collection is visible, all mutations and Save are disabled, and no retry, replacement, discard or resolution operation is dispatched.

controls.label: Close

options.label: Close read-only review
options.result: Closes the recovered-draft presentation while retaining the original rejected operation and its evidence as unresolved local pending work.

controls.result: No operation is dispatched and Review Rejected Draft remains discoverable. O-051 owns any future resolution or acknowledgment behavior.

transitions.event: Restart encrypted database, runtime, coordinator and editor
transitions.to: Exact persistent read-only rejected-draft review is available
Unchanged unresolved rejection with review still discoverable

states.name: Waiting, incomplete, unavailable, absent, or archived detail
states.expected: Edit cannot open and Save cannot dispatch.

states.name: Empty collection
states.expected: Editor can add a checklist or save the complete empty collection when it represents a semantic change.

states.name: Zero-item checklist
states.expected: Checklist remains valid and may receive an item later.

states.name: Queued or applying save
states.expected: Draft result remains visible, duplicate Save is disabled, and pending state survives restart.

states.name: Rejected or revision-conflicted save
states.expected: Unsupported optimism settles only against refreshed complete detail, while the exact accepted command remains durably recoverable for read-only review across restart. Retry linkage, resolution and optional acknowledgment remain blocked by O-051.

acceptanceChecks.expected: Open, every catalogued draft action, pre-acceptance Cancel, Save, pending, rejection, exact read-only recovery, Close and readback traverse one shared complete-replacement workflow without inventing rejection resolution.

Every claimed editor control and accessibility identity compiles, while model tests exercise its enabled/disabled rule, transition, empty state, and conflict behavior; full simulator interaction remains a release gate rather than a package-test claim.

Save reuses atomic encrypted acceptance, exact replay, restart restoration, and exact rejected-command recovery through a fresh store, coordinator and editor without dispatching duplicate, retry, discard or resolution commands.
Only exact represented Space and operation evidence can settle the editor save; stale, foreign, malformed and incomplete evidence fails closed.

deferredBehaviors: The duplicate Space Options launcher is not claimed by this bounded section workflow.
Space name/notes, completion, templates, media, Items/placement, archive and accounting are separate workflows.
Hosted authenticated Supabase/PowerSync upload and revocation proof remains gated by A-003/A-004.
blockers: The read-only portion is implemented and tested: a rejected checklist operation retains its complete command envelope in the encrypted local operation journal, survives encrypted database/store and fresh coordinator/editor restart, and remains reviewable without mutation or another write.

O-051 blocks retry-resolution, replacement linkage and any evidence-retaining do-not-retry acknowledgment. Until approved, recovered rejection review is non-mutating; Cancel, close, navigation and restart leave it unresolved, no feature-level discard exists, and this workflow cannot be marked complete.

review.summary: Independent review initially rejected unsafe empty recovery defaults, a contradictory explicit-retry workflow transition, missing recovery controls, misleading recovered-empty copy, absent cross-layer restart proof, stale guard assertions, state mismatch and missing authority citations. All findings were corrected. Final re-review returned GO with no P0-P3 findings after 37 focused tests, standalone environment/state/conversion gates, source-batch synchronization and exact authority checks passed.
